subject: geography
title: Slums and Informal Settlements: Dharavi
welcome_lead: Walk through Dharavi in Mumbai — one of Asia's largest informal settlements and a thriving economic engine.
meta_desc: Geography Adventure: slums and informal settlements with Dharavi as case study.
final_note: You have walked Dharavi's lanes. Informal settlements are not just problems — they are part of city life.

concepts.def: UN-Habitat definition: settlement lacking durable housing, sufficient space, water, sanitation or security of tenure.

walkthroughs.body_html: The UN estimates that over 1 billion people live in slums and informal settlements. Numbers are rising as cities grow faster than formal housing supply. Inequality, weak land markets and rapid migration concentrate risk in slums.

Dharavi houses approximately 1 million people in roughly 2.1 km². Despite challenges with sanitation and overcrowding, its informal economy — leather goods, pottery, textiles, recycling — turns over an estimated US$1 billion annually. Residents include diverse castes, religions and regions of origin.

Slum policies range from forced clearance to in-situ upgrading (Dharavi Redevelopment Project) and site-and-service schemes (Aranya, Indore). Granting tenure can spark self-investment. Successful models recognise residents as agents and integrate participation, infrastructure and livelihoods.

mcqs.q: Why is ocean acidification a separate threat from ocean warming?
options: Ocean acidification is caused by acid rain falling on the sea.
Continental crust subducts because it is thicker and heavier.
Ocean acidification is just another name for ocean warming.
Acidification occurs because oceans absorb atmospheric CO2, forming carbonic acid and lowering pH — this dissolves calcium carbonate shells and corals, independent of any warming.

mcqs.q: Why does oceanic crust subduct beneath continental crust?
options: Continental crust subducts because it is thicker and heavier.
Oceanic crust subducts because the ocean pushes it down with its weight.
Ocean acidification is caused by acid rain falling on the sea.
Oceanic crust is denser (basaltic) than continental crust (granitic), so when they collide the denser oceanic plate sinks into the mantle, forming a trench and volcanic arc.

mcqs.q: Why are composite volcanoes more explosive than shield volcanoes?
options: Because composite volcanoes are taller and have more lava.
Continental crust subducts because it is thicker and heavier.
Composite volcanoes have high-silica, viscous magma that traps gas, causing pressure to build until violent eruption; shield volcanoes have runny basaltic lava that releases gas easily.
Because composite volcanoes are found in cold climates.
